fields.description: Issue includes editorial and political commentary on Dade County taxation and state revenue policy (Tallahassee), discussion of a criminal libel case involving Wen Phillips and Reubin Clein in Judge Brown's court and related local political disputes, and extensive local advertising and social items. Coverage also includes horse racing content and promotions (Tropical Park; "Jockey Jimmy" turf bulletin), Miami Beach municipal election results and local officeholders, and notices related to National Recovery Administration (NRA) code compliance by Miami-area plumbers and other businesses.
